registry_record.reference: BioScribe descriptor distance heuristic v1; no affinity reference
registry_record.algorithm: abs(MW-350)/350 + abs(TPSA-75)/75; lower is nearer chosen descriptor targets
registry_record.assumptions: unvalidated dimensionless ordering; target independent; not docking or binding energy

input_policy.text: One nonempty ASCII SMILES string without whitespace/control characters; no names or CXSMILES; no trimming or repair
input_policy.graph: Nonempty sanitized graph within the atom limit; no atomic-number-zero, query atoms or query bonds
input_policy.identity: Retain fragments, formal charges, isotopes and specified/unspecified stereochemistry; no salt stripping or tautomer/protonation adjustment
input_policy.interpretation: Syntactic/concrete-graph eligibility only; not endpoint-specific predictive validation
